query:
UPDATE collection_items
        SET
          location_changed_at = CASE WHEN ?2 IS NOT NULL
            THEN strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')
            ELSE location_changed_at END,
          updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'),
          location_id = ?2
        WHERE id = ?1 AND location_id IS NOT ?2
